schema.name: agent_assets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_assets (
        agentId   TEXT NOT NULL,
        assetId   TEXT NOT NULL,
        createdAt INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (agentId, assetId),
        FOREIGN KEY (assetId) REFERENCES assets(id)
      )

schema.name: agents
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE agents (
        id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name         TEXT NOT NULL,
        spec         TEXT NOT NULL,
        cwd          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        acpSessionId TEXT,
        status       TEXT NOT NULL,
        createdAt    INTEGER NOT NULL,
        closedAt     INTEGER
      )

schema.name: assets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE assets (
        id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        mimeType  TEXT NOT NULL,
        size      INTEGER NOT NULL,
        createdAt INTEGER NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
        agentId TEXT NOT NULL,
        seq     INTEGER NOT NULL,
        kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload TEXT NOT NULL,
        ts      INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (agentId, seq)
      )
